text: {"label":"Trauma-Informed Care and Posttraumatic Stress","definition":"Integrating trauma-informed care principles into behavior-analytic assessment, treatment, training, and research, plus behavioral approaches to posttraumatic stress symptoms such as behavioral activation and valued living.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on trauma history and posttraumatic stress, not acquired brain injury rehabilitation, inpatient psychiatric or serious mental illness care, or treatment of self-injurious behavior."}
